customer_ledger_sign_matches_type.name: customer_ledger_sign_matches_type
customer_ledger_sign_matches_type.value:
"customer_ledger"."amount" <> 0 AND (
        ("customer_ledger"."type" IN ('charge', 'interest') AND "customer_ledger"."amount" > 0) OR
        ("customer_ledger"."type" IN ('payment', 'refund', 'void') AND "customer_ledger"."amount" < 0) OR
        "customer_ledger"."type" = 'adjustment'
      )

customers_interest_valid.name: customers_interest_valid
customers_interest_valid.value: ("customers"."interest_mode" IS NULL AND "customers"."interest_rate_bp" IS NULL AND "customers"."interest_started_at" IS NULL) OR ("customers"."interest_mode" IS NOT NULL AND "customers"."interest_rate_bp" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 AND "customers"."interest_started_at" IS NOT NULL)

stock_movements_sign_matches_type.name: stock_movements_sign_matches_type
stock_movements_sign_matches_type.value:
"stock_movements"."quantity_milli" <> 0 AND (
        ("stock_movements"."type" IN ('receive', 'refund', 'void', 'repack_in') AND "stock_movements"."quantity_milli" > 0) OR
        ("stock_movements"."type" IN ('sale', 'waste', 'expired', 'repack_out', 'supplier_return') AND "stock_movements"."quantity_milli" < 0) OR
        "stock_movements"."type" = 'adjust'
      )
